mika: Quick check — aiming for 12:00 UTC cutoff for v2.3.2. Can everyone confirm version bumps and changelog updates? Need a green CI sweep by 11:30. Ping @ricardo for flaky tests.
ricardo: Looking now, I have a failing test in auth-integration that's flaky. Re-running.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @ricardo — build #5421 queued.
ashley: Changelog updated in PR #2176, version bump to v2.3.2 applied on main.
devon: All feature branches merged into staging. Please hold merges to main after 11:50.
mika: Copy that. Also can someone run `./scripts/collect-smoke.sh` and paste failures here if any?
ricardo: Rerun passed on first attempt but auth-integration popped again locally.
ricardo: I'll instrument the test. Quick snippet I ran locally:
```
pytest tests/integration/test_auth.py::TestAuthIntegration::test_session_refresh -k session -vv
``` 
ricardo: The failure looks timing-related, increasing wait fixed it locally.
ops-bot: Canary pool healthy — no infra alerts in us-west or eu-central.
emily: I can do the green sweep at 11:05 UTC and report back.
emily: 11:06 UTC — smoke results: all passing except TestUserSessionExpiry is flaky (1/8 failures).
ashley: I pushed a small timeout bump in the test in PR #2180, will merge after final green.
mika: Thanks. If the auth-integration flake persists, fallback plan: cut a patch release with the flaky test ignored and follow up with an investigation ticket.
ricardo: Acknowledged. I'll open the patch PR and create an issue for root-cause analysis.
ci-bot: Build #5423 completed — all checks green, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/5423/
mika: Sweet. Final reminder — cutoff 12:00 UTC. Please don't merge non-essential changes after 11:50. :thumbsup:
ashley: Noted :thumbsup:
emily: Green sweep complete at 11:28 UTC — tagging release candidate and creating release notes draft.
ops-bot: Release candidate healthcheck: p95 latency 110ms, error rate within baseline.
mika: Thanks team — proceeding with bump and release at 12:00 UTC. If anything blocks, post here and we'll triage.
